newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto chemical units valued.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto chemical units valued.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst Paul Raman said Thursday he values Monsanto Co's chemical operations at roughly $3 a share, with the company's life sciences businesses valued at about $42 a share.
-- This followed Monsanto's announcement that it is considering spinning off its chemical operations, merging them with other companies, or keeping and restructuring the businesses.

-- Raman based his valuations on a 1996 earnings estimate of $1.45 a share. Of that, he estimates the chemical operations will earn about $0.23 a share. The "new Monsanto" -- consisting of life sciences businesses such as agricultural chemicals, biotechnology, food additives and pharmaceuticals -- would earn about $1.22 a share.
-- Raman said he expects Monsanto will opt to spin off its chemical businesses, although he estimates the operations could fetch $2.6 billion in a sale.
-- "I would say they are (likely to) spin off chemicals. It's not an area of focus any more for the company," Raman said. "The focus is really their agricultural business."
-- Raman continues to rate Monsanto a buy.
